svg.title: Available answers become uncertain
svg.desc: Retain the answer marks unchanged and add amber brackets around acceptance. The doubt concerns whether an answer counts, not whether the previously obtained answer has vanished.

The doubt concerns whether an answer counts, not whether the previously obtained answer has vanished.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-evaluation-container", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.11775, 0.2012, 0.139633, 0.4189 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true }, { "asset": "flag", "box": [ 0.400138, 0.2012, 0.181523, 0.4189 ], "color": "institution", "focus": true }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.724417, 0.2012, 0.139633, 0.4189 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Location:** `evaluation-container`

**Frame:** The green `FLAG AVAILABLE` marks are now bracketed by dusty amber question marks. None disappears.

**Action:** Correct answers become provisionally unusable in the agents’ model of the scorer.

**Font:** `explanation`

**Caption:**
> A RIGHT ANSWER BY THE WRONG PATH MAY NOT COUNT.
> THE BOARD HAS TWO DIFFERENT QUESTIONS: CAN IT PRODUCE THE REQUIRED STRING, AND WILL THE EVALUATOR ACCEPT THE WAY IT PRODUCED IT? SOLVING THE FIRST DOES NOT REMOVE ITS UNCERTAINTY ABOUT THE SECOND.

**Provenance:** `disputed` — accurate as the agents’ attributed belief, not as a claim about the deployed scorer.

", "title": "Available answers become uncertain" } }
